name: Healer
description: A star reporter, a second-rate journalist and a man by the code name "Healer" are brought together by a long-buried incident that hides dark truths.

videos.title: I Have a Dream
videos.overview: Seo Jeong-hu, aka Healer, is one of the best in the "courier" business. His next job should be simple – or so says his hacker partner, Ms. Jo.

videos.title: Fate Continues
videos.overview: Healer's attempt to get a sample for DNA testing leads to a scary encounter for Yeong-sin. Later, Mun-ho gets a call from the DNA lab.

videos.title: The First Kiss That Day
videos.overview: Healer decides to spy on Yeong-sin for clues about who framed him but discovers that someone else is secretly watching her as well.

videos.title: Because I'm Next to You
videos.overview: When Ms. Jo opposes his plans to go undercover, Healer assures her that it won't take long. Yeong-sin tries to convince her boss to publish her story.

videos.title: Meaning of You
videos.overview: Mun-ho mentions Ji-an to Myeong-hui and ends up confronting Mun-sik. Fearing that Bae Sang-su may catch him, Ms. Jo tells Healer to avoid Yeong-sin.

videos.title: Begin
videos.overview: By manipulating the media, Mun-sik turns Joo Yeon-hui's case on its head. Feeling lost with no other options, Yeong-sin calls Mun-ho for help.

videos.title: We, Under the Sunset
videos.overview: Mun-sik orders a background check on Yeong-sin to see if she was adopted. Mun-ho tasks Bong-su with uncovering Hwang Je-guk's licentious private life.

videos.title: Cannot Be Forgotten
videos.overview: Shocked to see an email notification for Mun-ho sent from Healer, Yeong-sin interrogates Mun-ho about his relationship with Healer.

videos.title: I Trust You
videos.overview: Mun-ho threatens to tell Myeong-hui everything if something happens to Ji-an again. Mun-sik is running out of time to turn in Ko Seong-cheol's killer.

videos.title: Can't It Be Me?
videos.overview: At Someday News, everyone eagerly awaits Yeong-sin's reporting. Mun-sik and Boss watch the live broadcast of Kim Ui-chan's candidacy announcement.

videos.title: In the Darkness
videos.overview: Back home from work, Mun-ho discovers that there’s been an intruder and receives a call from a restricted number asking about what happened in 1992.

videos.title: I Don't Know How to Escape
videos.overview: Mun-ho is furious at his brother for coming to visit Someday News. Jeong-hu meets one of his father's close friends.

videos.title: I'm Waiting
videos.overview: Bae Sang-su is confident that he has finally caught Healer. Mun-sik arrives at the Double S Guard's headquarters to meet the man they brought in.

videos.title: It's Alright Even If You Cry
videos.overview: Ms. Jo tries to hack into the police server to obtain Yeong-jae's statement. Yeong-sin gets worried when Bong-su becomes unreachable.

videos.title: I Remember
videos.overview: Jeong-hu contemplates how he’ll reveal his truest self to Yeong-sin – and when. Someday News prepares its attack on Mun-sik's campaign.

videos.title: To You Again
videos.overview: Jeong-hu follows a lead given by Mun-ho to find the truth behind his father's case. Ms. Jo notices something off about Yeong-sin's location tracker.

videos.title: Won't You Answer Me?
videos.overview: Yeong-sin's stunned face replays in Jeong-hu's mind, but he tries to focus on getting his father's statement. Yeong-sin visits Myeong-hui at home.

videos.title: Just Like the Others
videos.overview: Jeong-hu confronts Boss. Fearing for Jeong-hu's safety, Yeong-sin tries to follow him inside. Mun-ho airs the content of the audiotape on live news.

videos.title: I'll Protect You
videos.overview: Tracking the location of Mun-ho's phone, Jeong-hu arrives at Someday to find that no one’s there. Mun-ho's phone rings, but the caller ID is blocked.

videos.title: Goodbye Healer
videos.overview: Jeong-hu resorts to plan B when he hits roadblocks trying to prove his innocence and the people closest to him come under attack.
